errors.noSubtitlesIn: This video has no subtitles in {{languages}}.

ytdlp.ageRestricted: This video is age-restricted and cannot be downloaded without a signed-in account.
ytdlp.botBlock: Bot protection triggered. The IP you're using is most likely flagged (datacenter range or busy VPN exit). Change your IP or pick a different VPN endpoint and retry. If it keeps failing, this may be a temporary site-side change — Arroxy updates its download engine on launch, so the fix lands automatically once it ships.
ytdlp.chunkTransferFailure: The server kept cutting the download mid-stream, and Arroxy gave up after retrying. This usually hits the largest video formats (4K HDR / high-bitrate VP9). Retry, switch network/VPN, or pick a lower-resolution format.
ytdlp.drmProtected: This video is DRM-protected. Arroxy can't remove DRM, so the file can't be downloaded.

ytdlp.geoBlocked: This video is not available in your region.
ytdlp.ipBlock: Your IP address appears to be blocked. Try again later or use a VPN.
ytdlp.loginRequired: This video needs a signed-in account.

ytdlp.network: Network error. Check your connection and retry.
ytdlp.noSubtitles: This video has no subtitles in the requested languages.
ytdlp.outOfDiskSpace: Not enough disk space. Free up space and retry.
ytdlp.outputNotWritable: Arroxy can't write to the download folder. It may be read-only, on a locked drive, or blocked by your system's privacy settings. Choose another folder or allow access, then retry.
ytdlp.parse: Couldn't parse the response from the site. The site may have changed how it serves videos. Arroxy updates its download engine on launch — retry in a few minutes once the fix ships.
ytdlp.postprocessFailure: The download finished, but post-processing (merge / mux / convert) failed. Often this is a transient ffmpeg issue — retry, and if it persists try a different format combination.
ytdlp.rateLimit: The site is rate-limiting requests from this connection.
ytdlp.unavailable: This video is unavailable — it may be private, deleted, or region-locked.

review.changed: Changed from {{profile}}: {{areas}}. Applies to this download only.

nextTime.title: This download used edited settings. Use them next time?

save.description: Keeps these settings as a profile you can pick next time. Your Quick Download profile stays the same.
save.title: Save as profile

update.builtinNote: This is a built-in profile. You can restore its original settings in the Profiles tab.
update.description: From now on, every download with this profile uses the new settings.
update.title: Update “{{profile}}”?

modeHint.off: No SponsorBlock — video plays as uploaded.
modeHint.remove: Cuts sponsor segments from the video using FFmpeg.

subtitles.autoAssNote: Auto-captions will be saved as SRT instead of ASS — for YouTube videos they're cleaned of rolling-cue duplication, which our ASS converter can't replicate yet.
subtitles.embedNote: Embed mode saves output as .mkv so subtitle tracks embed reliably.
subtitles.noLanguages: No subtitles available for this video

analytics.toggleDescription: No telemetry. Once a day, an anonymous heartbeat sends the app version, install channel, OS, language, country and roughly how long ago Arroxy was installed, so we can count active and new users. No IDs, URLs, video titles or filenames.

autoRemoveCompleted.description: Takes a download off the Downloads list a few seconds after it finishes. The files stay in your folder; failed and cancelled downloads stay in the list.
autoRemoveCompleted.label: Remove finished downloads

autoRetry.description: Automatically tries again after a network or server hiccup, waiting longer between each attempt. Downloads blocked by the site are never retried automatically.
autoRetry.label: Retry failed downloads

clipboard.bulkHint: Multiple links copied — use Bulk URLs to add them
clipboard.readFailed: Couldn't read the clipboard — paste the link into the field instead
clipboard.toggleDescription: Auto-fill the URL field when you copy a video link.

closeToTray.toggleDescription: Continue downloads in the background after closing the window.

concurrentDownloads.description: How many queued items download at the same time. More at once finishes a long queue sooner, but raises the chance a site limits you.
concurrentDownloads.label: Downloads at once

cookies.banWarning: Sites like YouTube may flag — and sometimes ban — accounts whose cookies are used by download tools like Arroxy. Use a throwaway account when possible.
cookies.browserHelp: Reads cookies directly from the browser. The browser must be closed for Chromium-family browsers.
cookies.enabledButNoBrowser: Pick a browser to use cookies
cookies.enabledButNoFile: Pick a file to use cookies
cookies.exploreDescription: Uses your Explore sign-in only when a download needs it.
cookies.exploreDisabled: The Explore tab is off, so downloads don't use your Explore sign-in. Turn it on under Explore below.
cookies.risk: Risk: a cookies.txt contains every logged-in session for that browser — keep it private.
cookies.toggleDescription: Helps with age-restricted, members-only, and account-private videos.

downloadConnections.description: Speeds up large downloads by fetching several parts of a video at once. Higher values raise the chance a site limits you.
downloadConnections.label: Download connections

url.fetchFormatsTooltip: Step-by-step wizard. Choose format, quality, and more.
url.heading: Download from URL

hotkey.conflict: This shortcut is taken by another app — pick another one.
hotkey.sectionDescription: Download whatever link you copy, from any app, without opening Arroxy.
hotkey.toggleDescriptionDetail: Copy a video link in any app and press the shortcut: Arroxy queues it with your active profile, without switching windows. A link to a video in a playlist downloads the video.

limitRate.activeWarning: Active downloads keep their current limit. Pause + Resume to apply changes.
limitRate.description: Cap bandwidth for media downloads. Request pacing below is usually the stronger rate-limit lever.
limitRate.invalid: Use a number followed by K or M (e.g. 500K, 1.5M)
limitRate.label: Download speed limit

url.mascotBusy: Downloading in the background… I can multitask 😎
url.mascotCollection: Quick queues loaded items with {{profileName}}. Interactive lets you inspect or select items first.
url.mascotIdle: Drop a link and let Arroxy pull it ✨
url.mascotPreparing: {{quickDownload}} is reading this link and applying {{profileName}}.
url.mascotQueued: The queue is handling this download. You can paste another link while it works.
url.mascotSingle: Quick starts one download with {{profileName}}. Use Interactive for one-off changes.
url.mascotVideoInList: This link names a video and the list it’s in: download just the video, or the list.

nativeAudioPreference.description: Stereo or surround when a profile picks native audio. A profile can override it.
nativeAudioPreference.label: Native audio preference

networkPacing.description: Add small waits during each download so Arroxy does not hit the site too aggressively. Values are in seconds.
networkPacing.heading: Gentle downloads
networkPacing.summary: Waits: {{requests}} between checks, {{downloads}} before media starts, {{subtitles}} before subtitle files.
networkPacing.tooltip: These waits happen inside each download. How many downloads run at the same time is set separately, under Downloads at once.

tooltips.balanced: Default. Adds short pauses between requests and before media starts.
tooltips.careful: Adds longer pauses for large playlists or networks that frequently hit limits.
tooltips.custom: Tune the advanced per-download controls yourself.
tooltips.off: Uses only the small baseline pauses Arroxy keeps for media and subtitles.

openedLink.replaced: Replaced with the link opened in Arroxy

playlistProbeLimit.customDialogDescription: Use a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
playlistProbeLimit.description: Maximum entries Arroxy loads when a playlist, channel, or search result is opened.
playlistProbeLimit.invalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 5000
playlistProbeLimit.label: Playlist items to scan

playlistScope.applyError: Could not apply that playlist scope: {{message}}
playlistScope.dialogDescription: Choose what Arroxy loads for this playlist.
playlistScope.invalid: Use whole item numbers from 1 to {{max}}, with the start no higher than the end.
playlistScope.label: Playlist scope

profile.destinationEditHint: To change where it saves, edit the profile.
profile.enableHint: Hidden profiles stay here but disappear from every profile picker.
profile.lastEnabledHint: Keep at least one profile available.
profile.menuDescription: Change the active profile for Quick Download, Bulk URLs, and playlists.
profile.moveCancelled: Move cancelled. {{profileName}} stays in position {{position}} of {{count}}.
profile.moveInstructions: To move a profile, press Space or Enter, move it with the arrow keys, then press Space or Enter to drop it. Press Escape to cancel.
profile.movePickedUp: Picked up {{profileName}}. It is in position {{position}} of {{count}}.
profile.outputMissing: This profile saves to a folder that isn't set. Choose a folder in the profile, or set it back to the default.
profile.panelDescription: Create, select, edit, or remove reusable download setups.
profile.reorderHint: Drag a profile to move it. Every profile picker follows this order.

proxy.description: Route traffic through a proxy — useful for geo-restricted content.
proxy.label: Proxy URL

url.quickBulkAllFailed: None of those URLs could be prepared
url.quickPartialFailed_one: Queued what worked. {{count}} URL could not be prepared.
url.quickPartialFailed_other: Queued what worked. {{count}} URLs could not be prepared.
url.quickPrepareFailed: Queue item could not be prepared
url.quickSingleOnly: Paste a video, playlist, channel, or search URL to get started.

settings.behaviorDescription: Global behavior that affects profile-driven downloads too.

aurora.description: Glass panels over a moving sky. Needs graphics acceleration.
aurora.label: Aurora

minimal.description: Solid, quiet surfaces. Runs light on any computer.
minimal.label: Minimal

style.modeDescription: Both styles come in light and dark.
style.panelDescription: How Arroxy looks. Switch between light and dark in the footer.
style.unavailableNotice: {{style}} needs graphics acceleration, which isn't available right now, so Arroxy is showing {{fallback}}.
